# Semantic failure clusters

::: {.hub-record-hero .hub-idea-hero}
<p class="hub-idea-status">Idea · Medium priority · 2/9 readiness fields complete</p>

<p class="hub-takeaway">Group similar ranking failures to find request types where a method repeatedly struggles.</p>
<p>Recurring failure patterns could show where a ranking method needs a different evidence strategy or should not be used.</p>

<p class="hub-github-issue"><a href="https://github.com/npatta01/trec_mlm_2026/issues/50">Track in GitHub #50</a></p>

<p class="hub-next-action">State a falsifiable hypothesis and evaluation boundary for the clustering test.</p>
:::


<details class="hub-details">
<summary>Evidence and current knowledge</summary>
## How does it work?

- Represent development failures using bounded query and ranking evidence.
- Cluster similar failures and describe the resulting query types.
- Test whether the clusters predict weakness on a held-out development partition.

## What do we know?

Clustering can describe repeated failures, but a useful test still needs a
falsifiable hypothesis and a boundary that prevents tuning on evaluation
labels.
</details>
